headline: 動原体の酵素KKT23は、トリパノソーマのH2Aをアセチル化する
subhead: 酵素ドメインの結晶構造はGCN5に最も近く、KKT23を減らすとH2Aのアセチル化が下がった

summary.question: 動原体のタンパク質KKT23はアセチル基転移酵素ドメインを持つが、その機能も構造も分かっていなかった。
summary.approach: 酵素ドメインをX線結晶構造解析とNMRで調べ、ヒストンのアセチル化を試験管内とKKT23を減らした細胞で調べた。
summary.result: 酵素ドメインはヒトGCN5に近く（RMSD 1.2 Å）、H2A C末端の尾部のK119など5か所をアセチル化した。
summary.learned: KKT23はGCN5に似た構造の酵素で、トリパノソーマのH2A C末端の尾部のアセチル化の一部はKKT23に依存する。
summary.open: H2AのK115・K119・K120を修飾する酵素や、KKT23によるアセチル化の意義は今後の課題だ。

question.quote: KKT23 is a constitutively localized kinetochore protein containing a C-terminal acetyltransferase domain of unknown function.
The function or structure of KKT23 remains unknown.

approach.quote: Here, using X-ray crystallography and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy, we have determined the structure and dynamics of the KKT23 acetyl-transferase domain from Trypanosoma brucei
We find that KKT23 can acetylate the C-terminal tail of histone H2A and that knockdown of KKT23 results in decreased H2A acetylation levels in T. brucei.

result.quote: The structural alignment between KKT23125−348 and human GCN5 revealed a remarkable similarity, with a root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) of 1.2 Å (114–114 Cα atoms)
We found that lysine residues on the C-terminal tail of H2A were robustly acetylated (K119, K120, K122, K125, and K128)

learned.quote: These results show that the hyperacetylation of the histone H2A C-terminal tail partly depends on KKT23 in vivo.
Taken together, our structural characterization reveals that KKT23 has an acetyltransferase fold with the closest structural similarity to GCN5 histone acetyltransferases.

open.quote: It will be important to identify which acetyltransferase(s) are responsible for the H2A C-terminal acetylation in the future.
It will also be important to reveal the functional significance of histone H2A acetylation by KKT23.

highlights.text: 酵素ドメインに最も近い構造はヒトGCN5のヒストンアセチル基転移酵素ドメインだった。KKT23にはGNATの基本の折りたたみにない余分のα7とβ8があり、キネトプラスト間で保存されている。

evidence.quote: Notable differences between the two structures include the additional α-helix (α7) and β-strand (β8) in the crystal structure of KKT23125−348, which are highly conserved among kinetoplastids but are not part of the consensus GNAT domain fold (Figures 4A and S6)

highlights.text: KKT23はトリパノソーマのヌクレオソームのH2A C末端の尾部を強くアセチル化したが、ヒトのヌクレオソームでは信号が見えなかった。GCN5がH3・H4を主に修飾するのとは基質の好みが異なる。

evidence.quote: but not when H. sapiens nucleosomes were used, suggesting that KKT23 is specific toward T. brucei nucleosomes
KKT23 therefore has different substrate specificity compared to GCN5 acetyltransferases in other eukaryotes that are known to preferentially acetylate histones H3 and H4 but not H2A.

highlights.text: N末端領域（残基2–70）の結晶構造は2.7 Åで、短いヘリックス3本からなる。DALI検索で明らかな類似構造は見つからなかった。この領域だけでKKT22との結合に十分らしい。

evidence.quote: The structure comprises three short helices between residues 22–33, 36–49, and 54–62.
Based on the observation that the N-terminal region of KKT23 is sufficient to interact with KKT22 in this assay

lab_notes.expression: 酵素ドメインとN末端領域は大腸菌BL21(DE3)で発現した。KKT22・KKT3との共発現はSf9昆虫細胞で行った。
lab_notes.construct: 全長では結晶が得られず、酵素ドメイン（125–348、アセチルCoA存在下）とN末端領域（2–70）を結晶化した。
lab_notes.purification: TALONでHisタグ付きを精製し、TEVでタグを切った後、イオン交換とゲルろ過で精製した。
lab_notes.sample_prep: 酵素ドメインは4 °CでアセチルCoAを加えて結晶化した。N末端領域の結晶は18 °Cで40日後に現れた。
lab_notes.data_collection: Diamond Light SourceのI03・I04で回折データを集めた。NMRは750 MHzで測定した。

evidence.quote: Protein expression was induced with 0.2 mM IPTG and was continued for ~16 h at 20°C.
these proteins were co-expressed in insect cells (Sf9) and pulled down using FLAG-KKT23
However, no crystal for the full-length protein was obtained.
To cleave off the His-tag, samples were incubated with TEV protease in 1:50 w/w ratio overnight
The samples were then further purified using ion exchange and size exclusion chromatography.
Native crystals of Trypanosoma brucei KKT23125-348 (14.5 mg/mL) were grown at 4°C
X-ray diffraction data from selenomethionine crystals of Trypanosoma brucei KKT23125-348 were collected at the I03 beamline at the Diamond Light Source
All NMR spectra were acquired using a 750 MHz spectrometer

editor_notes: 新しい構造は9EVQ（天然、1.75 Å）・9F5Q（SeMet）・9EVR（N末端、2.7 Å）。結晶構造の全体にはリガンドとしてアセチルCoAが入る。AlphaFold2・AlphaFold-Multimerの予測は補助で、結論の根拠にはしていない。KKT22との相互作用は断片のプルダウンで示され、複合体の構造はない。Methodsの後半（MS・ChIP-seq）は読み飛ばした。
